hip-32349.x: Core administrative sector of the Galactic Empire and early Spacer settlement hub in Isaac Asimov’s Robots and Foundation series.
Massive, egg-shaped moon of a gas giant at Sirius; high equatorial gravity holds a dense atmosphere while polar peaks protrude into vacuum.
Human frontier colony world orbiting Sirius, a critical strategic bulwark against extraterrestrial incursions.
Brightest star in Earth’s night sky (mag -1.46, 8.6 ly), paired with white dwarf companion Sirius B ("The Pup").
